note: Lean works with the product S1*P inside the AM-GM step rather than the square-root integrand itself, with log W/log(W/2q) written as 1 + log 2q/log(W/2q) and the factor 4 absorbed into x sqrt(m/2phi).

snippet.text:
set h := H2 (x / (W * U)) + zeta3 * √(x / W) / U
  have hS1 : S1 x U W ≤ x / W * h := by
    refine (S1_bound hx hW0 hU1).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    simp only [h, zeta3]
    rw [rpow_three_halves _ hx.le, rpow_three_halves _ hW0.le, Real.sqrt_div' _ hW0.le]
    have : 0 < √W := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hW0
    field_simp

proof_context.conclusion: S1 x U W <= (x/W) h with h = H2(x/(WU)) + zeta3 sqrt(x/W)/U, the factor under the square root in the display (2h = 2H2 + (kappa_4/2) sqrt((x/WU)/U)).

snippet.text:
have T1 : a * √P ≤ x * √(m / (2 * Nat.totient q)) *
      ((β * (1 + Real.log c / L) + h / β) / 2) := by
    have e1 : x / W * h * P = (x * √(m / (2 * Nat.totient q))) ^ 2 *
        ((β * (1 + Real.log c / L)) * (h / β)) := by
      simp only [P]
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), hlogW]
      field_simp; try ring
    rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), e1, Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity),
      Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
    gcongr
    exact sqrt_le_amgm (by positivity) (by positivity)

proof_context.conclusion: The product S1 * P (P the main S2 term with log W/L, c = 2q, m = 1/4) is rewritten as (x sqrt(m/2phi))^2 (beta(1+log c/L))(h/beta) and bounded by AM-GM.
